I have successfully prevented VLC Media Player from auto-closing once the video ends. 

**What was done:**
1. Opened VLC's Tools menu and accessed Preferences
2. Switched to Advanced Preferences (All settings view)
3. Navigated to Interface > Main interfaces > Playlist
4. Found the "Play and exit" checkbox in the Playlist settings
5. Unchecked the "Play and exit" option
6. Saved the preferences

**Result:**
The "Play and exit" setting controls whether VLC automatically closes after a video finishes playing. By disabling this option, VLC will now remain open after playback completes, allowing you to continue using the player or add more media files without it closing unexpectedly.

The change has been saved and will take effect immediately for any new videos you play in VLC.
